parameters.text:
=👋 Welcome {{ $('Telegram Trigger').item.json.message.chat.first_name }}!  
I'm your personal AI assistant for business and personal task management.  
📋 /tasks — View all your pending tasks
📅 /today — What you need to do today 
➕ /add — Add a task manually 
✅ /done — Mark a task complete 
🗓 /week — Your week summary  
Or just type/send a voice note with your tasks!
➕ *Add a new task*  Describe your task naturally: - "Call Houston client Friday at 2pm, business" - "Book dentist next week, personal" - "Send contract to notary by Thursday, high priority"

=✅ Which task did you complete?
Reply with the number:

{{ $json.message }}

Just type the number (1, 2, 3...) and I'll mark it done.
✅ Tasks saved! Send /tasks to see everything or /today for your briefing.
✅ Tasks saved from your voice note! Send /tasks to see everything.

=✅ *{{ $('Resolve Done').item.json.title }}* marked as complete! 
Well done 💪

=✅ *{{ $('Resolve task').item.json.title }}* marked as complete! 
Well done 💪

parameters.jsonBody:
={
  "model": "claude-sonnet-4-20250514",
  "max_tokens": 2000,
  "messages": [
    {
      "role": "user",
      "content": "Today is {{ $now.toISO() }} CDT (America/Chicago). Write a weekly overview for {{ $('Telegram Trigger').item.json.message.chat.first_name }}.

All pending tasks:
{{ $('Retrieve week tasks').all().map(t => `[${t.json.category.toUpperCase()}] ${t.json.title} | due: ${t.json.deadline || 'no deadline'} | priority: ${t.json.priority}`).join('\n') }}

Write exactly ONE message in this exact style — warm, smart, like a trusted assistant talking to a friend:

## Weekly Overview for [first name]

📅 This Week — Business
[tasks with deadlines, flag urgent ones naturally, one smart tip per group]

👤 This Week — Personal
[tasks with deadlines, one smart tip]

🔮 Later / No Deadline
[brief mention of tasks with no deadline]

💡 Weekly Strategy
[3-4 warm sentences: honest assessment of the week, what to focus on first, encouraging close]

Emoji rules:
- Use emojis naturally like 🔴 for urgent, ✅ for completed, 📌 for important
- Use them to make tasks easier to read at a glance
- One or two per section max

Example tone:
'You are in good shape! Manageable week with clear priorities. Knock out the urgent ones today then enjoy a smooth rest of the week. You have got this! 💪'

Strict rules:
- ONE single message only, never split
- Maximum 3-4 lines per task including its tip
- Weekly Strategy section maximum 4 sentences
- If there are many tasks group similar ones together rather than cutting them out
- Bullet points for tasks
- Warm, direct, encouraging throughout
- No extra sections beyond the four above"
    }
  ]
}
